name: YMCA Camp Mountain Laurel Day Camp
operator_name: Hamden/North Haven YMCA (Central Connecticut Coast YMCA)
description_short: Summer day camp run by the Hamden/North Haven YMCA at Camp Mountain Laurel on Downes Road in Hamden. Activities include nature exploration, swimming and archery, and there is a Counselor in Training program for 14-15 year olds.
special_needs_notes: Children who need special assistance or medicine at camp may need an Individual Care Plan and a Medicine Authorization form.

warnings: The page only has 2026 materials (brochure, handbook, registration packet). The 2026 summer is over as of 2026-10-13, and nothing for 2027 has been posted.
No session dates, prices or age range appear on the page. They are probably in the linked 2026 brochure/FAQ PDFs, which were not part of the source text.

The phone number and P.O. Box (Hamden, CT 06517) are the footer contact for the YMCA's website, not necessarily the camp's own contact details. The zip code was left blank because it belongs to the P.O. Box.
The page also describes YMCA Camp Hi-Rock, a separate overnight camp in the Berkshires (Mount Washington, MA). It is not included in this listing.
